question: Should OpenClaw accept the grouped-JSON, one-Claw-adds-one-agent contract as the durable product direction and transition RFC 0016 from draft to accepted?
rationale: The documents are coherent and the prior review defect is resolved, but automation cannot authorize a new cross-repository package format, CLI surface, persistent ownership model, or compatibility promise.

options.title: Accept and transition the RFC
options.body: Approve the current narrowed grouped-JSON contract, create or designate the implementation issue, update the RFC to accepted, and retain the experimental gate during rollout.

options.title: Narrow before acceptance
options.body: Identify the specific CLI, schema, ownership, or registry commitments that must be deferred and revise the normative contract before changing its status.

options.title: Continue incubation
options.body: Keep the RFC open as a draft while the linked implementation stacks gather additional product and upgrade evidence without creating a permanent compatibility commitment.

recommendation.title: Accept and transition the RFC
recommendation.body: Approve the current narrowed grouped-JSON contract, create or designate the implementation issue, update the RFC to accepted, and retain the experimental gate during rollout.

likelyOwner.reason: This person supplied the adopted product model and has directly relevant merged lifecycle ownership history, making them the strongest visible routing candidate for the acceptance decision.
